title: "He calls the generations from the head": Atzilus as the revelation of Adam Kadmon's hidden will
overview:
The chapter asks how the ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus* come from *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon*, and answers with "He calls the generations from the head": the hidden comes out into revelation. The lines that lay out that idea, from the comparison of the glow to the will in the soul, are in the chapter, but no class of the series explains them: tape 029 reads the opening lines and then holds a class on chapter 20.

The classes take up the application. The *Kesarim* of *Atzilus* are only revealed will, and their hidden source is the will for a will of *Adam Kadmon*, as a man's revealed kindness comes from his picture of himself as an *ish chesed*. That will for a will is general and bears many particular wills. In particular, the *Malchus* of each attribute of *Adam Kadmon* becomes the *Keser* of that attribute in *Atzilus*. The parenthesis gives the rule for every level: what the Rebbe says, or writes in this book, is his *Malchus*, and it becomes the *Keser* of the *chassid*, "a very big thing" that explains all the levels.

terms.gloss: revelation of what is hidden: a glow of the essence coming out, not a power spreading from it by cause and effect
cause and effect; from the last level of the cause comes the head and root of the effect
a will for a will: the hidden will of Adam Kadmon, general, from which the revealed wills of Atzilus come
the crowns: the Keser of each of the ten sefiros of Atzilus, only a revealed will
a man of kindness; the picture of himself a man has, like Adam Kadmon, from which his revealed kindness comes
the sawing apart; where the Malchus of a sefira becomes that sefira of the Malchus
the end of the deed: the last level of the ratzon kadum, from which comes the Keser of the will for a will

sections.title: The question: the ten sefiros of Atzilus are rooted in Malchus of Adam Kadmon
sections.summary: The chapter sets out to understand the root of the ten emanated *sefiros*: the *Etz Chaim* says it is *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon*, from which comes *Keser* of *Atik Yomin*.

phrases.he: (יט) ומעתה יש להבין בשרש עשר ספירות הנאצלים,
phrases.en: (19) Now we must understand the root of the ten emanated *sefiros*,

phrases.he: ששרשם מבחינת מלכות דאדם קדמון
phrases.en: whose root is from *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon*,

phrases.he: כמו שכתוב בעץ חיים בשער הכללים
phrases.en: as is written in *Etz Chaim*, in the Gate of the General Principles,

phrases.he: דמבחינת מלכות דאדם קדמון נעשה כתר דעתיק יומין כו'
phrases.en: that from *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon* comes *Keser* of *Atik Yomin*.

skip.note: Class 029 opens by reading lines 1 to 7 straight through, with no translation or comment; the phrases are a plain rendering.

sections.title: Revelation of the hidden is a glow, not a power spreading from the essence
sections.summary: "He calls the generations from the head" is *gilui ha'helem* (revelation of what is hidden): a hidden thing coming out into revelation, which is not *ila v'alul* (cause and effect) but a glow of the essence, like movement from a living being or letters from thought, truer than the flame hidden in the coal. The series has no recording that explains these lines.

phrases.he: והנה תחלה יש להקדים בענין עשר ספירות הגנוזות בהעלם,
phrases.en: Now first we must preface the matter of the ten *sefiros* hidden away in concealment,

phrases.he: איך שיוצאים לידי גלוי
phrases.en: how they come out into revelation.

phrases.he: שזהו מה שכתוב קורא הדורות מראש,
phrases.en: This is what is written, "He calls the generations from the head":

phrases.he: מראש דאדם קדמון כו'
phrases.en: from the head of *Adam Kadmon*.

phrases.he: ואמר בספר יצירה שזהו כשלהבת הקשורה בגחלת,
phrases.en: And *Sefer Yetzira* says that this is "like a flame bound to a coal";

phrases.he: וכהאי גוונא יש דמיונות רבים
phrases.en: and there are many comparisons of this kind.

phrases.he: ויובן יותר מי' כחות הנפש
phrases.en: It will be understood better from the ten powers of the soul.

phrases.he: דהנה ידוע ענין העלם וגלוי אינו כהתפשטות כח מן העצם,
phrases.en: For it is known that concealment and revelation is not like a power spreading forth from the essence,

phrases.he: כמו כח הפועל שמתפשט בפעולה,
phrases.en: like the power of the doer that spreads into the deed,

phrases.he: שזהו מהות כח העצם שנקרא עילה ועלול
phrases.en: which is the very being of the essence's power, and is called cause and effect.

skip.note: Read in class 029 without comment; the reading breaks off in the middle of line 7, where the tape goes over to a class on chapter 20. The phrases are a plain rendering.

phrases.he: אלא כמו בחינת זיו ואור של העצם
phrases.en: but like a glow and a light of the essence,

phrases.he: כהארת זיו אור השמש,
phrases.en: like the shining of the glow of the sun's light,

phrases.he: וכחיות אור הנפש בכלי הגוף,
phrases.en: and like the life of the soul's light in the vessels of the body,

phrases.he: וכהתחכמות מכח השכל וכהאי גוונא
phrases.en: and like being clever, from the power of the intellect, and the like.

phrases.he: והיותר דמיון אמיתי לגלוי ההעלם
phrases.en: And the truest comparison for the revelation of the hidden

phrases.he: הוא כמו גלוי התנועה מן החי
phrases.en: is like the revelation of movement from the living being,

phrases.he: וכאותיות המחשבה ואותיות הדיבור וכהאי גוונא
phrases.en: and like the letters of thought and the letters of speech, and the like.

skip.note: Lines 8 to 39 are not heard in the series: on tape 029 a class on chapter 20 takes their place. The phrases are a plain rendering.

phrases.he: וכל זה יותר אמיתי מדמיון שלהבת הקשורה בהעלם בגחלת
phrases.en: All this is truer than the comparison of the flame bound up in concealment in the coal.

phrases.he: שאף על פי שבגחלת היה השלהבת בהעלם,
phrases.en: For although in the coal the flame was hidden,

phrases.he: אבל הרי על כל פנים ממהות חום שבגחלת יצא השלהבת,
phrases.en: still, at any rate, the flame came out of the very being of the heat in the coal,

phrases.he: ואין זה אמיתית ענין הגלוי
phrases.en: and that is not the truth of revelation;

phrases.he: רק כמו בחינת מראה וגוון לבד,
phrases.en: [true revelation is] only like a look and a color alone,

phrases.he: כגוון התפוח שאינו ממהות התפוח, וכידוע
phrases.en: like the color of the apple, which is not of the apple's very being, as is known.

sections.title: In the soul: the source of a will is the attribute itself, the revealed will only its showing
sections.summary: An essential attribute of *chesed* or of cruelty brings a will and an intellect for kindness or for judgement into being. The source of that will is still the attribute itself; the will revealed in a particular matter is only a showing of it, as life shows in movement, and one general will for a will bears many particular wills. The series has no recording of these lines.

phrases.he: וכך הוא בגלוי העלם עצם כחות הנפש,
phrases.en: So it is in the revelation of the hidden essence of the soul's powers,

phrases.he: כמו כח מדת החסד בעצם
phrases.en: like the power of the attribute of *chesed* in the essence.

phrases.he: שגלוי שלו היינו כאשר מצד עצמיות מדה זו בעצם הנפש,
phrases.en: Its revelation is this: because of the very essence of this attribute in the essence of the soul,

phrases.he: הרי מתהווה רצון ושכל של חסד וטוב תמיד
phrases.en: a will and an intellect of kindness and good always come into being;

phrases.he: ולהיפך במי שמדתו העצמית באכזריות,
phrases.en: and the opposite: in one whose essential attribute is cruelty,

phrases.he: מתהווה רצון ושכל לדין ועונש
phrases.en: there comes into being a will and an intellect for *din* (judgement) and punishment.

phrases.he: והנה התהוות מקור לרצון זה, לחסד או לדין,
phrases.en: Now the coming into being of a source for this will, for kindness or for judgement,

phrases.he: נחשב עדיין מעצם המדה,
phrases.en: is still counted as of the essence of the attribute,

phrases.he: שאינו נבדל הימנה כלל
phrases.en: for it is not separate from it at all.

phrases.he: אבל מה שנולד רצון בגלוי לדין או להיפוכו,
phrases.en: But that a will is born in revelation, for judgement or the opposite,

phrases.he: זהו רק כמו בחינת התגלות מראה לעצם
phrases.en: that is only like the showing of a look of the essence,

phrases.he: כהתגלות התנועה בעצם החי
phrases.en: like the revelation of movement in the living being itself,

phrases.he: וכגלוי החיות בדבר נבדל, שהוא הגוף
phrases.en: and like the revelation of life in a separate thing, which is the body:

phrases.he: שמפני שהוא חי בעצם, מגלה חיותו בתנועה
phrases.en: because it is alive in its essence, it reveals its life in movement;

phrases.he: וכן מפני שהוא דבר חי בעצם, מחיה גם לגוף הדומם
phrases.en: and likewise, because it is a living thing in its essence, it gives life even to the inanimate body,

phrases.he: שנקרא חיי בשר כו'
phrases.en: which is called "the life of the flesh."

phrases.he: כי גלוי רצון זה בא בדבר נבדל,
phrases.en: For the revelation of this will comes in a separate thing,

phrases.he: שהוא ענין זה של חסד או דין
phrases.en: which is this particular matter of kindness or judgement;

phrases.he: אבל מקור המוליד רצון זה הוא בא מכח עצם המדה לבד
phrases.en: but the source that gives birth to this will comes from the power of the essence of the attribute alone.

phrases.he: ומובן ממילא,
phrases.en: And it is understood of itself:

phrases.he: בהיות שיש כמה אופני דברים שיוליד רצון מיוחד לכל אחד
phrases.en: since there are many kinds of things, it gives birth to a will of its own for each one

phrases.he: ממקור אחד,
phrases.en: from one source,

phrases.he: שהוא תלוי בעצם המדה תמיד כו'
phrases.en: which always depends on the essence of the attribute.

phrases.he: וגם שכל המטה תמיד כלפי רצון וחסד,
phrases.en: And also an intellect that always tilts toward will and kindness

phrases.he: היינו רק מצד עצם מדת החסד
phrases.en: is only because of the essence of the attribute of *chesed*,

phrases.he: שמוליד תמיד רצון ושכל לחסד דוקא
phrases.en: which always gives birth to a will and an intellect for kindness, *davka*.

phrases.he: ויש כמה ענינים נבדלים
phrases.en: And there are many separate matters,

phrases.he: ולכל אחד מוליד רצון ושכל בפני עצמו כו' ודי למבין
phrases.en: and for each one it gives birth to a will and an intellect of its own. This is enough for one who understands.

phrases.he: ונמצא שהרצון לרצון של חסד בכלל,
phrases.en: So the will for a will of kindness in general

phrases.he: יוכל להוליד כמה רצונות של חסד בפרט,
phrases.en: can give birth to many wills of kindness in particular,

phrases.he: בכמה ענינים שונים באופנים שונים מאד
phrases.en: in many different matters, in very different ways,

phrases.he: והכל ממקור אחד,
phrases.en: and all from one source,

phrases.he: שהוא רצון הנעלם הנקרא עצם הרצון של חסד,
phrases.en: which is the hidden will called the essence of the will for kindness,

phrases.he: מצד עצמיות המדה ההיולית
phrases.en: because of the essence of the attribute in its *hiyuli* (raw potential) state;

phrases.he: רק שבא בדרך פרט להיות רצון לרצון זה בדבר פרט זה כו' ודי למבין.
phrases.en: only it comes *derech prat* (in a particular way), to be this will for a will in this particular thing. This is enough for one who understands.

phrases.he: ומובן על כל פנים שיש הפרש גדול בין גלוי הרצון לחסד,
phrases.en: At any rate it is understood that there is a great difference between the revelation of the will for kindness,

phrases.he: שאינו רק בחינת גלוי ההעלם של עצם הרצון, המוליד רצון זה
phrases.en: which is only a revelation of what is hidden in the essence of the will that gives birth to this will,

phrases.he: שהוא בא מכח עצם המדה,
phrases.en: and [the essence of the will itself,] which comes from the power of the essence of the attribute

phrases.he: שהוא אינו בחינת נבדל כו' ודי למבין.
phrases.en: and is not something separate. This is enough for one who understands.

sections.title: The Kesarim of Atzilus only reveal the hidden will of Adam Kadmon
sections.summary: The ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus* are only the hidden come out into revelation, a glow and not a new thing. So the *Keser* of each of them is only a revealed will, coming out of the hidden will for a will that is *Adam Kadmon*, as a man's revealed kindness comes out of his picture of himself as a man of kindness.

phrases.he: ועל דרך משל זה יובן
phrases.en: By way of this analogy we will understand

phrases.he: ענין קורא הדורות מראש דאדם קדמון כו'
phrases.en: "He calls the generations from the head" of *Adam Kadmon*:

phrases.he: כמשל הקורא דבר שיצא מהעלמו לגלוי לחוץ
phrases.en: like one who calls out a thing, which went out of its concealment into revelation outside;

phrases.he: כך כל עיקר בחינת עשר ספירות דאצילות
phrases.en: so the whole essence of the ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus*

phrases.he: הוא שיצאו מהעלמם לגלוי בלבד
phrases.en: is that they went out of their concealment into revelation, and no more.

phrases.he: ועל כן נקראו בשם אורות או ספירות, כמו זיו ואור
phrases.en: That is why they are called lights, or *sefiros*, like a glow and a light.

phrases.he: וכמו כל בחינת גלוי ההעלם שאינו רק בבחינת אור,
phrases.en: Like any revelation of the hidden, which is only a light,

phrases.he: וכבחינת מראה וגוון,
phrases.en: like a look and a color,

phrases.he: וכמו תנועת החי כו'
phrases.en: and like the movement of the living being.

phrases.he: והיינו כמו ויאצל מן הרוח,
phrases.en: And this is like "and He set apart from the spirit":

phrases.he: שאין זה רוחו של משה
phrases.en: this is not the spirit of Moshe [itself],

phrases.he: רק בחינת גלוי אורו וזיוו לבד, הוא שנאצל והופרש,
phrases.en: only the revelation of his light and glow alone was what was emanated and set apart,

phrases.he: כגלוי שלהבת מן הגחלת וכהאי גוונא כו'
phrases.en: like the revelation of a flame from the coal, and the like.

phrases.he: וכל זה יובן על פי משל הנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: All this is understood by the analogy mentioned above

phrases.he: מענין גלוי הרצון בדבר נבדל
phrases.en: of the revelation of the will in a separate thing,

phrases.he: שיוצא מהעלם עצם הרצון שמצד עצמיות כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: which comes out of the concealment of the *etzem haratzon* (the essence of the will) that comes from the very essence, as mentioned above.

phrases.he: כך בחינת כתרים דעשר ספירות דאצילות
phrases.en: So the *Kesarim* (crowns) of the ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus*

phrases.he: הן רק בחינת גלוי רצון
phrases.en: are only a revelation of will

phrases.he: לגבי העלם עצם הרצון שנקרא רצון לרצון,
phrases.en: relative to the concealment of the essence of the will, which is called the will for a will,

phrases.he: שהוא בבחינת אדם קדמון כנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: which is in *Adam Kadmon*, as mentioned above.

blocks.text: **which comes out of the concealment of the *etzem haratzon* (the essence of the will) that comes from the very essence**: so **the *Kesarim* (crowns) of the ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus* … are only a revelation of will** relative to the hidden essence of the will, which is called the *ratzon l'ratzon* (the will for a will) and is in *Adam Kadmon*. Over here he calls *Adam Kadmon* the *etzem haratzon*.

phrases.he: וכמו מבחינת העלם הרצון דחסד דאדם קדמון
phrases.en: Like from the hidden will of *chesed* of *Adam Kadmon*

phrases.he: נמשך גלוי רצון לחסד דאצילות
phrases.en: is drawn a revealed will for *chesed* of *Atzilus*,

phrases.he: שנקרא כתר דחסד כו'
phrases.en: which is called *Keser* of *chesed*;

phrases.he: וכן מבחינת העלם רצון דחכמה כו'
phrases.en: and so from the hidden will of *chachma* (wisdom).

blocks.text: **Like from the hidden will of *chesed* of *Adam Kadmon* … is drawn a revealed will for *chesed* of *Atzilus***. In a person: *Adam Kadmon* means the first conception of himself, what kind of person he is going to be, his self-image of being an *ish chesed* (a man of kindness). From the *chesed* of that comes a revealed will for *chesed*, actually coming out in a particular *chesed*, and that is what is called **Keser of *chesed***. So the source of *Keser* of *chesed* is in *chesed* of *Adam Kadmon*; **and so from the hidden will of *chachma* (wisdom)**.

sections.title: The will for a will comes in general and bears many particular wills
sections.summary: The will for a will is general; out of the one will for a will for *chesed* in *Adam Kadmon* are born many kinds of revealed will of *chesed* in *Atzilus*.

phrases.he: אך כמו שמובן ממשל הנזכר לעיל
phrases.en: But as is understood from the analogy mentioned above,

phrases.he: שזהו הנקרא התהוות רצון לרצון,
phrases.en: that this is what is called the coming into being of a will for a will,

phrases.he: הרי הוא בא בבחינת הכלל
phrases.en: it comes in a general fashion,

phrases.he: להוליד כמה מיני רצון וכמה ענינים אופנים שונים כו',
phrases.en: to give birth to many kinds of will, and many matters, all kinds of different ways in particulars;

phrases.he: כך מבחינת רצון לרצון לחסד באדם קדמון
phrases.en: so from the will for a will for *chesed* in *Adam Kadmon*

phrases.he: נולד כמה מיני גלוי רצון של חסד באצילות
phrases.en: are born many kinds of revealed will of *chesed* in *Atzilus*.

blocks.text: This thing that is called the coming into being of a will from a will, **it comes in a general fashion**. Out of it come many kinds of will, in many matters, **all kinds of different ways in particulars**. And in the same way **from the will for a will for *chesed* in *Adam Kadmon* … are born many kinds of revealed will of *chesed* in *Atzilus***.

sections.title: In particular: the Malchus of each attribute of Adam Kadmon becomes the Keser of that attribute in Atzilus
sections.summary: In general only *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon* becomes *Keser* of *Atzilus*, which is *Atik*; in particular the *Malchus* of each attribute of *Adam Kadmon* becomes the *Keser* of that attribute of *Atzilus*, by way of *Malchus*. And *Adam Kadmon* itself comes from the end of the deed of the *ratzon kadum*.

phrases.he: והענין הוא
phrases.en: And the matter is this:

phrases.he: דמבחינת המלכות של מדה דאדם קדמון
phrases.en: from the *Malchus* of an attribute of *Adam Kadmon*

phrases.he: נעשה בחינת כתר דמדה דאצילות
phrases.en: comes the *Keser* of the attribute of *Atzilus*;

phrases.he: ובכללות העשר ספירות
phrases.en: and in the ten *sefiros* as a whole,

phrases.he: הרי רק מבחינת מלכות דאדם קדמון נעשה כתר דאצילות
phrases.en: only from *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon* comes *Keser* of *Atzilus*.

blocks.text: **And the matter is this**: so far it was in general, and now he is going to tell it in more particular. In particular, **from the *Malchus* of an attribute of *Adam Kadmon* … comes the *Keser* of the attribute of *Atzilus***. And **in the ten *sefiros* as a whole, … only from *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon* comes *Keser* of *Atzilus***.

blocks.question: From Malchus of chesed of Adam Kadmon comes Keser of chesed of Atzilus; but really only Malchus of Adam Kadmon as a whole becomes the Keser, that is Atik of Atzilus. So how does that work?
blocks.text: Everything really goes through *Malchus*. *Malchus* of *chesed* of *Adam Kadmon* becomes *chesed* of *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon*. You know how that works; that comes later on, in the *nesira* (the sawing apart): the *Malchus* of a *sefira* becomes that *sefira* of the *Malchus*. And then *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon* becomes *Keser* of *Atzilus*.

So *chesed* of *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon* becomes *chesed* of *Keser* of *Atzilus*, and *chesed* of *Keser* of *Atzilus* becomes *Keser* of *chesed* of *Atzilus*. That is how, from *Malchus* of *chesed* of *Adam Kadmon*, comes *Keser* of *chesed* of *Atzilus*. There are all kinds of more and more particular ways to figure this out. But in general you can say directly that from the *Malchus* of an attribute of *Adam Kadmon* comes the *Keser* of that attribute of *Atzilus*, even though in general *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon* becomes *Keser* of *Atzilus*. What does it mean?

phrases.he: והוא רק מבחינת אותיות וגלוי עצם העלם הרצון,
phrases.en: That is, only from the letters and the revelation of the essence of the hidden will

phrases.he: נעשה אור העצם של גלוי רצון כו'
phrases.en: comes the essential light of the revealed will.

blocks.text: **That is, only from the letters and the revelation of the essence of the hidden will … comes the essential light of the revealed will.** He is going to explain this in the parenthesis. And the explanation in the parenthesis is not only on this: it is in general on the whole *inyan* (matter) of how the *Malchus* of the upper becomes the *Keser* of the lower.

phrases.he: (שהוא כמו שמבואר באות הי''ח דרק מבחינת סוף מעשה דעצם הרצון
phrases.en: (As explained in [chapter] 18, only from the *sof maaseh* (the end of the deed) of the essence of the will

phrases.he: נעשה רצון לרצון
phrases.en: comes the will for a will,

phrases.he: שהוא עשר ספירות דאדם קדמון)
phrases.en: which is the ten *sefiros* of *Adam Kadmon*.)

blocks.text: The next class opens on it: "This next little thing here is very important, because it doesn't only apply to this chapter, but it applies to everywhere." He means not the first parenthesis but the second, the one that begins "For example": the speech of the *mashpia* (the giver) and the *mekabel* (the receiver).

**As explained in [chapter] 18, only from the *sof maaseh* (the end of the deed) of the essence of the will … comes the will for a will**. Notice that here he does not call the will for a will the essence of the will, as he did before. Here **the essence of the will** means the *ratzon kadum* (the preceding will). From the *sof maaseh* of the *ratzon kadum* comes out the *Keser* of the will for a will, **which is the ten *sefiros* of *Adam Kadmon***.

And now comes the example, and it is not just for this chapter. It shows how the *Malchus* of the upper becomes the crown of the lower in general, and also how the *Malchus* of an attribute of the upper becomes the *Keser* of that attribute of the lower. This is not just in this *inyan* here but everywhere: from *Malchus* of *chesed* of *Atzilus* comes *Keser* of *chesed* of *Beriya*.

sections.title: The parenthesis: the giver's speech becomes the receiver's essence
sections.summary: The revealed will and the letters of the teacher's speech, his *Malchus*, become the essence of the will and of the intellect in the student, his *Keser*; so in every cause and effect, and so *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon* becomes *Keser* of *Atik Yomin*. This is how the ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus* came out of the concealment of *Adam Kadmon*.

phrases.he: (על דרך דוגמא,
phrases.en: (For example:

phrases.he: מגלוי רצון שבדבור המשפיע
phrases.en: from the revealed will in the speech of the *mashpia* (the giver)

phrases.he: נעשה עצם הרצון למקבל
phrases.en: comes the essence of the will in the *mekabel* (the receiver);

blocks.text: **from the revealed will in the speech of the *mashpia* (the giver) … comes the essence of the will in the *mekabel* (the receiver)**. That means: from the *Malchus* of *Keser* comes *Keser* of *Keser* in the *mekabel*, in the lower level.

blocks.title: The Rebbe says what he wants
blocks.text: What does it mean? For instance, the Rebbe says something, and in his speech, which is his *Malchus*, he reveals that he wants the *chassidim* (his followers) to do such and such a thing, "like let's say take over the world". This becomes the essence of the will in the *mekabel*. So that's like *Keser*.

phrases.he: כמו שמאותיות גלוי השכל שבדבור שבמשפיע
phrases.en: just as from the letters of the revealed intellect in the speech of the *mashpia*

phrases.he: נעשה עצם אור השכל במקבל
phrases.en: comes the essential light of the intellect in the *mekabel*;

blocks.text: **just as from the letters of the revealed intellect in the speech of the *mashpia* … comes the essential light of the intellect in the *mekabel***.

blocks.title: This book, right here
blocks.text: Like what we're doing right here. Instead of speech you can say writing: the letters of the revelation of the *sechel* (intellect) in the writing of the Rebbe, this book, become by us the essential light of the *sechel*. These letters, by the Rebbe, are the end of the letters, the *Malchus* of *Malchus*; by us they become the actual *Keser* of our *sechel*, the essential light of the intellect in the *mekabel*.

phrases.he: וכך רק מאותיות וגלוי חסד שבדבור דמשפיע
phrases.en: and so only from the letters and the revelation of kindness in the speech of the *mashpia*

phrases.he: נעשה אור הרצון לחסד למקבל
phrases.en: comes the light of the will for kindness in the *mekabel*;

phrases.he: כידוע בכל עילה ועלול,
phrases.en: as is known of every cause and effect,

phrases.he: שמבחינת האחרונה שבעילה נעשה ראש ושרש לעלול
phrases.en: that from the last level of the cause comes the head and root of the effect.

blocks.title: Go out and help Jews
blocks.text: **and so only from the letters and the revelation of kindness in the speech of the *mashpia* … comes the light of the will for kindness in the *mekabel***. If the Rebbe says you should go out and help Jews, put *tefillin* on with people, help them and bring them close, this becomes the light of the will for *chesed* in the *mekabel*, by the *chassid*.
And this you can see in any attribute, **as is known of every cause and effect, … that from the last level of the cause comes the head and root of the effect**.

phrases.he: וכך מבחינת מלכות דאדם קדמון בכלל
phrases.en: And so from *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon* in general

phrases.he: נעשה בחינת כתר דעתיק יומין כו'
phrases.en: comes *Keser* of *Atik Yomin*;

phrases.he: דהיינו מבחינת גלוי רצון לרצון שבדבור בלבד,
phrases.en: that is, only from the revealed will for a will in speech,

phrases.he: נעשה בחינת מקור כל גלוי רצון שמצד התענוג
phrases.en: comes the source of every revealed will that comes from the *taanug* (delight),

phrases.he: שנקרא כתר דעתיק יומין כו'
phrases.en: called *Keser* of *Atik Yomin*,

phrases.he: וכמו שיתבאר)
phrases.en: as will be explained.)

blocks.text: **And so from *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon* in general**: the same as in particular, the same thing in general, it **comes *Keser* of *Atik Yomin***. The general talk of the Rebbe becomes the general *Keser* of the *chassid*. **that is, only from the revealed will for a will in speech**, meaning just the final speech, so to speak, of the will for a will, **comes the source of every revealed will that comes from the *taanug* (delight)**, called *Keser* of *Atik*, as will be explained later.
"And this little parenthesis is a very big thing that explains on all the levels."

phrases.he: והיינו כללות ענין העשר ספירות דאצילות
phrases.en: And this is the general matter of the ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus*,

phrases.he: שיצאו מהעלם עשר ספירות דאדם קדמון,
phrases.en: which came out of the concealment of the ten *sefiros* of *Adam Kadmon*,

phrases.he: כמו שכתוב קורא הדורות מראש כו':
phrases.en: as it is written, "He calls the generations from the head."

blocks.text: **And this is the general matter of the ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus***: what was talked about in this chapter. The ten *sefiros* of *Atzilus* just came out of the concealment of the ten *sefiros* of *Adam Kadmon*, in a way of only a *gilui* (revelation). As it says, **"He calls the generations from the head"**: He calls out the generations from the head of *Adam Kadmon*. "That's chapter 19."

reviewQuestions.question: In a person, what is *Adam Kadmon*, and how does *Keser* of *chesed* of *Atzilus* come out of it?
What does it mean that the will for a will "comes in a general fashion"?
If only *Malchus* of *Adam Kadmon* as a whole becomes *Keser* of *Atzilus*, how does *Malchus* of *chesed* of *Adam Kadmon* become *Keser* of *chesed* of *Atzilus*?
In the first parenthesis, what does "the essence of the will" mean, and what comes out of its end of the deed?
How do the Rebbe's speech and this book show the *Malchus* of the giver becoming the *Keser* of the receiver?
